---
title: "Authoring"
subtitle: "Tag the content that the reader can hide."
description: "Add the class veil and the attribute group to slides, sections, blocks, spans, callouts, figures, tables, and code cells."
---

## Enable Veil

Add the filter to the document.
For a Reveal.js deck, add the plugin too.

```yaml
filters:
  - veil
revealjs-plugins:
  - veil
```

The `revealjs-plugins` entry has no effect in other formats.

## Tag content

The class `.veil` marks an element as veiled.
The attribute `group` gives the names of its groups, separated by spaces.
An element without `group` belongs to the default group `veil`.

````markdown
## Deep dive {.veil group="advanced"}

::: {.veil group="expert"}
Proof sketch.
:::

Some text [with an aside]{.veil}.

::: {.callout-note .veil group="advanced"}
A note for experts.
:::

![A detail](detail.png){#fig-detail .veil group="expert"}

## Backup: raw numbers {.veil group="advanced backup"}
````

A group name matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$`.
Any other name stops the render with an error.

For a code cell, set the class and the group in the cell options.

````markdown
```{{r}}
#| classes: veil
#| group: expert
summary(model)
```
````

With Jupyter, this form depends on the engine passing the option to the cell.
If it does not work, put a `.veil` Div around the cell.

## Headers and sections

A header with `.veil` applies to the section that the header opens.
In Reveal.js, this section is a slide.

- A `#` header in Reveal.js opens a vertical stack.
  `.veil` on it applies to the full stack.
- In Reveal.js, a header below `slide-level` opens no slide.
  Veil puts the header and its content in a `.veil` Div, so the result is the same as in HTML.
- In Reveal.js, a `.veil` Div that contains headers at slide level is removed.
  Veil puts its class and groups on each of these headers.
  Content before the first header goes into a new `.veil` Div.
- A `.veil` Div that contains `---` gets a warning, because a block cannot span two slides.

## More than one group

An element can belong to more than one group.

```markdown
## Backup: raw numbers {.veil group="advanced backup"}
```

The element is visible only when all its groups are shown.
This rule also applies to a veiled element inside another veiled element.

## Positions that Veil does not support

| Not supported | Use instead |
| --- | --- |
| `.veil` on a tab header in a tabset | A `.veil` Div inside the tab. |
| `.veil` on a callout title | `.veil` on the callout. |
| `.veil` on the title slide | No alternative: the title slide comes from metadata. |

: Unsupported positions of `.veil`. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[40,60]"}

A block cannot span two slides.
Veil does not show hidden content when a link points into it.
